card.name: The word be after should
card.fires_on: The word "be" (or "BE") right after "should" or "SHOULD" in passive phrases like "should be noted", "should be considered" and "SHOULD BE EMPHASIZED". Usually at the start of a sentence or after "this" or "it".

modes.label: It should be noted
modes.description: "be" after "It should" introducing a caveat or remark.
modes.example: It should<< be>> noted that, in some cases, the

modes.label: Should be considered / emphasized
modes.description: "be" after "this should" or in capitals "IT SHOULD BE" before a point to stress.
modes.example: IT SHOULD<< BE>> EMPHASIZED THAT DOSAGE REQUIREMENTS

card.writes: It lowers the chance of another "should" or "must"-type word coming next, since the verb is already in place.
card.plain: It marks the "be" in "should be noted" style sentences, where the sentence is already set up to give a remark.
